events.title: BrisScience: Every breath, every bite - the hidden journey of microplastics
events.location: The Edge, State Library of Queensland
events.description: A scientific exploration of the environmental and health impacts of microplastics, featuring expert researchers from UQ. The session includes a presentation followed by an interactive Q&A session with a curious, science-minded audience.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour QAG Highlights
events.description: A guided walkthrough of the gallery's collection focusing on significant works. Provides an opportunity to engage with art history and share observations with other attendees.

events.title: Through Mununjali eyes: photojournalist Wayne Coolwell exhibition Tour
events.location: kuril dhagun, State Library of Queensland
events.description: An exhibition tour featuring the powerful photographic work of Wayne Coolwell, exploring Indigenous perspectives and history. Offers a deep dive into visual storytelling and cultural history.

events.title: Portrait of an artist: Helga Groves
events.location: slq Auditorium 1, level 2, State Library of Queensland
events.description: An artist talk featuring Helga Groves, offering insights into her creative process, practice, and the conceptual underpinnings of her work. Ideal for those interested in contemporary visual art and the life of a working artist.

events.title: Creative digital memorials
events.location: The Edge, State Library of Queensland
events.description: A hands-on workshop exploring how to design and create digital tributes. Participants engage with modern digital tools in a collaborative, maker-space environment.

events.title: Tell stories with ipad
events.description: An introductory session on using digital tablets for narrative construction and visual storytelling. Perfect for individuals looking to explore creative technology in an accessible format.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour Art in Focus: Stories, Symbols & Perspectives
events.description: A curated tour of GOMA focusing on the narrative and symbolic elements of specific artworks. Encourages intellectual dialogue and communal appreciation of contemporary artistic practices.
